speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cold water, as promised. No crumb in the coat. If the stitch fails it will not be the loaf's fault, and you may tell her I said so.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will tell her nothing, because you will tell her yourself if you stand in this passage. The cloak is on the street door. Two is an hour, and the road is the same road as this morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I can hear the basin. I am not coming to inspect a jaw I have already inspected. Go, if you are going. Dinner was the proof. The street does not get a second one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The street is getting a man in a stitched coat, and no speech. I will be back when the yard is let out. You will get no title at the door and none at the coming back.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is off the stair. That is all the luck I have arranged. I have the board to scrape. I am not walking you to Bishopsgate to watch you be ordinary.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ordinary is the plan. If I am late, blame the ruts. Do not blame a conversation I am not going to have on the landing.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then have it in the street, with someone who is paid to listen, or with no one. The door is behind you. I am already at the board.
